hello.text: Sleeper. Stand up straight. You're going to be fine.

t0.text: Oozes in the stream, hornets in the brush, kobolds where kobolds shouldn't be. Nothing that'll beat you. Plenty that'll bruise you.

t1.text: Pick your fights. Don't pull two at once. And come back to the abbey when you're hurt. That's what it's here for.
